title: App Cannot Connect to Device
content:
If the app fails to connect, please check the following

  • Ensure your tablet or computer is connected to the same Wi-Fi network as the therapy machine.
  • Try restarting both the therapy machine and this application
  • Check the connection status indicator in the app's header for more details.

title: Data Not Updating
content:
If the therapy data (eg, temperature, pressure) is not updating on the screen Verify the Wi-Fi connection is stable.

The therapy session might be paused. Check the status and resume if necessary. A simple page refresh can often re-establish the data stream

title: Why does the app screen move or slide up when I start typing on my Android tablet?
content: On some Android tablets, the keyboard can appear in floating keyboard mode. In this mode, the keyboard is not attached to the bottom of the screen, which may cause the app screen to move, slide up, or appear shifted while typing.

title: How can I fix this problem?
content:
You can fix it by turning off the floating keyboard in your tablet settings.
Steps:
  1. Open the keyboard on your tablet.
  2. Tap the keyboard Settings or Keyboard options icon.
  3. Look for Floating keyboard or Floating mode.
  4. Turn it Off.
  5. Return to the app and try typing again.

After disabling the floating keyboard, the app screen should stay in place while you type.

title: Will this change affect my tablet permanently?
content: No. It only changes the keyboard display mode. You can turn floating keyboard mode back on at any time if you prefer.

title: I cannot find the floating keyboard option. What should I do?
content: Different tablet brands use different keyboard apps. Open the keyboard settings and search for Floating, Floating keyboard, or Keyboard mode. If you still cannot find it, check your tablet’s user manual or support page for keyboard settings.
